title: Humbanigash of Elam defeats Sargon II at Der
summary: The Babylonian Chronicle records a crushing defeat of Sargon’s army by Humbanigash of Elam at Der.
description: The Babylonian Chronicle records a crushing defeat of Sargon’s army by Humbanigash of Elam at Der. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 720, p. 44; Table 2, row 720, p. 40).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 720 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 720, p. 44; Table 2, row 720, p. 40
chronologies.note: Sargon’s army suffers a crushing defeat by Humbanigash of Elam at Der; Sargon’s annals substitute a victory over Samaria.
